{{Quote|That's the thing about these half-explored sectors&mdash;you never know when you might stumble across something fascinating.|[[Beryl Suttrige]], on the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]|<ref name="Gamer 9">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>}}
The '''freestanding subsectors''' were remote [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that had not received proper sector status from the galactic government due to their recent exploration. Freestanding subsectors were usually poorly-charted territories located on the boundaries of the known galaxy.

==History and definition==
In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] reorganized the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] space into 1,024 [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], each of them being represented by a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. The Ruusan Reformation also prohibited the creation of new sectors. However, unknown territories beyond the borders of the Republic at the time of the Ruusan Reformation were charted in the next centuries and integrated to Republic space. Such regions were at first included in existing outlying sectors but it soon appeared that this situation would not be not be sustainable in the long run. The border sectors could not be allowed to expand exponentially as long as the Republic grew. The problem was finally addressed by the implementation of new sector-like regions dubbed freestanding subsectors. These new sectors were roughly organized in a similar manner than regular sectors, but due to the Ruusan Reformation limitations, they were not granted proper Republic sector status. Freestanding subsectors therefore did not have their own senators; their representatives reported to an associated sector senator.<ref name="TEA" />

After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] abolished the moratorium on the creation of new sectors and reorganized the Republic freestanding subsectors into new sectors. Later, new territories integrated to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] became freestanding subsectors. These Imperial freestanding subsectors were intended to be eventually added to existing or newly created sectors.<ref name="TEA" />

==Astrography==
===Freestanding subsectors in the Galactic Empire===
The freestanding subsectors were remote [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. They also contained several [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the western parts of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], at the edge of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" />

====Wild Space====
The [[Farana (region)/Legends|Farana Space]] and the [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]] were freestanding subsectors located in the north-eastern Wild Space that bordered the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Farana Space was ruled by the [[Ocsin]] and named after their homeworld of [[Farana]].<ref name="TEA" /> The sector also contained the [[Hull's Star system/Legends|Hull's Star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Trianii Space was ruled by the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Trian/Legends|Trian]].<ref name="TEA" /> Trianii Space also contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Brochiib]], [[Ekibo]], [[Fibuli]], [[Monic]], [[Perin]] and [[Pypin]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Gradilis sector]] and the [[Maraqoo sector/Legends|Maraqoo sector]] were freestanding subsectors located in western Wild Space which bordered the Unknown Regions.<ref name="EAOC" /> The Gradilis sector contained the planet [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]].<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> The Maraqoo sector contained the [[Reo system/Legends|Reo system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

====Outer Rim====
The [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] was a freestanding subsector in the western Outer Rim that bordered the Unknown Regions.<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="Email" /> It contained the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln]] and the [[Spillwater system/Legends|Spillwater systems]].<ref name="EAOC" />

====Mid Rim====
The freestanding subsectors of the northern Mid Rim bordered the Unknown Regions and contained the planets [[Ankus/Legends|Ankus]], [[Burska]] and [[Voniss]].<ref name="EAOC" />

The [[Minyavi sector/Legends|Minyavi sector]] was a freestanding subsector located in the southern Mid Rim that bordered the Unknown Regions.<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="Email" /> It contained the [[Qaras system/Legends|Qaras system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Other freestanding subsectors of the southern Mid Rim contained the planets [[Gwar]], [[Mhatma 5]], [[Nopsin]] and [[Theal]], as well as the [[Meria system/Legends|Meria]] and [[Opitha Tren system/Legends|Opitha Tren systems]].<ref name="EAOC" />

In the eastern part of the Mid Rim, far above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane,<ref name="TOR:FA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref><ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Sebaddon system/Legends|Sebaddon system]] was located in a freestanding subsector.<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], in [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]], the planet [[Sebaddon]] was classified as part of the Unknown Regions.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618822|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:56 PM|quote=Yes, Oktos Sector is named for the nebula.}}</ref>

====Expansion Region====
The freestanding subsectors of the northern Expansion Region included the planets [[Escabar]], [[Pesitiin]], [[Roxuli/Legends|Roxuli]] and [[Thedavio VII]].<ref name="EAOC" />

The freestanding subsectors of the southern Expansion Region included the planets [[Aruza/Legends|Aruza]], [[Frewwil]], [[Kayri III]] and [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]], as well as the [[Lequabis system/Legends|Lequabis]] and [[Poviduze system/Legends|Poviduze systems]].<ref name="EAOC" />

===Pre-Imperial freestanding subsectors===
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the number of regional sectors increased significantly. As a result, new sectors were created in the Outer Rim Territories by the Galactic Empire from former freestanding subsectors.<ref name="EAOC" />

====Corporate Sector====
Soon after the [[Declaration of a New Order]],<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the modern Corporate Sector was established by expanding a freestanding subsector.<ref name="EAOC" /> The original Corporate Sector, formed in [[490 BBY]],<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> encompassed several hundred systems, all devoid of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life.<ref name="CSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Following the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] rise to power, [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] and the [[Galactic Corporate Policy League/Legends|Galactic Corporate Policy League]] convinced [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to dramatically expand the Corporate Sector to include nearly 30,000 systems. At the suggestion of Baron Tagge, the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] was created as the region's sole owner, employer, government and military.<ref name="TEA" />

====Hutt-dominated areas Rimward of Hutt Space====
By the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] held economic control over a large portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] however, the Hutts lost their sphere of influence Coreward of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the end of the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]], the Empire [[Annexation of the northern Hutt territories|annexed]] the [[Kreetan Narrows]] in the pursuit of [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

On the Rimward side of Hutt Space, the Empire also organized new sectors from Hutt Space and Wild Space systems.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> One such sector was the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]], which was created from various freestanding subsectors.<ref name="EAOC" /> Formerly part of Wild Space, [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] became the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Baxel sector and was given theoretical control of Hutt Space.<ref name="LoNH" />

====Moddell sector====
The Zuma regions, the [[Inner Zuma Region|Inner Zuma]] and the [[Outer Zuma]], were considered part of the Unknown Regions until the final [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the Republic. As these regions became more explored, what had been the Unknown Regions became Wild Space.<ref name="Gamer 9" />

Around [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]], when the Republic incorporated the Inner Zuma sectors,<ref name="Gamer 9" /> the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] was admitted as a freestanding subsector,<ref name="TEA" /> with [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] as its capital by default.<ref name="Gamer 9" /> Eventually, the Empire created the [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]] from various freestanding subsectors, including the Moddell sector.<ref name="EAOC" />
